error.account_rejected: Parro refused access to this account. Make sure it is a Parro parent account.

error.not_a_parent: This account is not a parent (guardian) account. Only parent accounts are supported.

error.two_factor: This account uses two-step verification, which Parro-HA does not support. Use a parent account without two-step verification.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.
error.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Parro account. Sign in with the account that was set up originally.

Other users can read the announcements in the Parro card only when they are chosen in the options. Show announcement details and Show conversation details make these texts readable by every user.

data_description.user: The Home Assistant user this Parro account belongs to. The Parro card shows this account to that user, and replies by that user are sent from this account. You can change it later with Reconfigure.
data_description.username: The e-mail address or username you use to sign in to Parro.

user.description:
Parro-HA is an unofficial open-source hobby project. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Parro or ParnasSys.

Sign in with the e-mail address (or username) and password of your Parro account. They are sent once, only to the official ParnasSys sign-in page, and are never stored. Home Assistant keeps a session that renews itself.

ParnasSys locks an account after a few wrong passwords. Home Assistant never retries a password on its own.
user.title: Sign in to Parro

authentication_failed.message: The Parro session has ended. Sign in again.

calendar_failed.message: Could not load the Parro calendar.

conversation_not_allowed.message: Replies to this conversation are not allowed. Choose it in the Parro options first.

conversation_not_available.message: This conversation cannot get a reply. Only active one-to-one and family conversations with replies turned on can.

conversations_off.message: Parro-HA does not keep the conversations of this account. Turn on Conversations in the Parro card in the Parro options.

duplicate_message.message: The same message was already sent, or perhaps sent, to this conversation in the last 6 hours.

entry_not_loaded.message: This Parro account is not loaded. Check that it is set up and working.

message_link.message: Messages with links, web addresses, IP addresses or e-mail addresses are not sent, for safety. Two words joined by a full stop, such as example.nl, count as a web address, and four numbers joined by full stops, such as 1.2.3.4, as an IP address.

message_markup.message: Only plain text is sent, without HTML, code, markdown links or template code. Leave out backticks, backslashes, square brackets, curly brackets, HTML tags and HTML codes, and put a space after an ampersand (&) or a less-than sign.

message_template.message: The message looks like an unknown value from a template, so it was not sent.

message_too_long.message: The message is longer than 1000 characters.

message_too_many_lines.message: The message has more than 20 lines.

no_account.message: Could not find your Parro account. Automations must choose the Parro account in the action.

rate_limited.message: Too many replies. Wait a minute between replies to the same conversation. At most 5 replies per hour and 20 per day are sent.

send_refused.message: Parro refused the reply. Sending is paused for an hour.

send_uncertain.message: Could not confirm that Parro received the reply. Check the conversation in Parro. If the reply is not there, word it differently, because the same text is not sent again within 6 hours.

sending_paused.message: Parro refused an earlier reply, so sending is paused for an hour.

update_failed.message: Parro gave an unexpected answer, so the Parro data was not updated.

update_unreachable.message: Could not reach Parro. The Parro data is updated again when Parro is back.

details_public.description: Show announcement details or Show conversation details is on for {title}, so announcement texts or conversation details are in entity attributes that every Home Assistant user can read. Accounts added before version 0.4.0 keep announcement details on, so that their cards and automations keep working. Once those use the Parro card and the Get announcements and Get conversations actions, turn both options off in the Parro options.
details_public.title: Parro texts are readable by every user

photos_public.description: Save photos in Media is on for {title}, so the photos of its announcements are saved in the local media folder of Home Assistant, by date and named after the Parro number of the announcement, at most 1600 pixels on the longest side and without metadata. Every Home Assistant user can browse them in Media and open them through Media links that work for a while without signing in. Apps and add-ons that can read the media folder, such as a Samba share, a media server or a NAS that shares the folder, can see them too. Backups that include the media folder contain them. Class photos usually show other people's children too. On Home Assistant Container, a folder must be mapped to /media first. To stop saving, turn Save photos in Media off in the Parro options. That keeps the saved photos, and a photo you delete is not saved again.
photos_public.title: Saved Parro photos are visible to every user

data.reply_conversations: Conversations Home Assistant may reply to
data.viewers: Other users who can read this account

data_description.announcement_count: Number of recent announcements in the Parro card, the pop-ups, the Get announcements action and the details of Latest announcement.
data_description.announcement_details: Adds the title, text and author of the latest announcements to Latest announcement, the title of the last announcement to each Class sensor, the title and group to the recent photos, and the title, group and author to Announcement events. Every Home Assistant user can read these, also in the pop-ups of this account. On for accounts added before version 0.4.0, so their cards, pop-ups and automations keep working, and off for new accounts. The account's own user and the users chosen below read the announcements in the Parro card without it.
data_description.announcement_photos: The Parro card and the pop-ups show up to 4 photos under each announcement, and all its photos in a slideshow when you tap one, only to the users who may read this account. On for new accounts. Accounts added before version 0.4.0 start with it off, so their cards look as before.
data_description.card_conversations: The Parro card and the pop-ups show the conversations of this account and the reply form to its own Home Assistant user. On for new accounts. Accounts added before version 0.4.0 start with the setting of Show conversation details, so their cards look as before. Without Show conversation details or a conversation Home Assistant may reply to, the Chat message event and the Get conversations action also need this option.
data_description.chat_details: Adds the names and the last message of the 10 most recent conversations to Unread conversations, and the sender and message to Chat message events. Every Home Assistant user can read these, also in the pop-ups. Off by default for privacy.
data_description.child_photos: An image entity with the profile photo of each child. Needs Children. Off by default, because every Home Assistant user can see image entities.
data_description.children: A device for each child with its class and its own calendar. Off by default, because device names contain your children's first names, which every Home Assistant user can see.
data_description.photo_count: Number of image entities with the most recent photos from announcements. 0 (off) by default, because class photos usually show other people's children and every Home Assistant user can see image entities. The Parro card shows them in a Recent photos block.
data_description.reply_conversations: One-to-one and family conversations that the Parro Send chat reply action may reply to, in plain text. None by default, which turns replies off. Only automations and the Home Assistant user of this account can send.
data_description.save_photos: Saves the photos of the announcements of this account in a folder Parro in the local media folder of Home Assistant, by date and named after the Parro number of the announcement, at most 1600 pixels on the longest side and without metadata. Every Home Assistant user can browse them in Media and open them through Media links that work for a while without signing in. Apps and add-ons that can read the media folder, such as a Samba share, a media server or a NAS that shares the folder, can see them too. Backups that include the media folder contain them. Class photos usually show other people's children too. On Home Assistant Container, a folder must be mapped to /media first. Off by default. Turning it off keeps the saved photos, and a photo you delete is not saved again.
data_description.update_interval: How often Parro is checked for new information.
data_description.viewers: Besides the Home Assistant user of this account, these users can read its announcements and photos in the Parro card and the pop-ups. Conversations and replies stay with the account's own user.

get_announcements.description: Returns the recent announcements of a Parro account from what Home Assistant already has, without asking Parro. For notifications and other automations. The answer is kept in the trace of the automation or script.

config_entry_id.description: The Parro account to read. Leave it empty to use your own Parro account. Automations must choose one.
config_entry_id.name: Parro account

count.description: How many of the newest announcements to return, at most the number set in the options. Empty returns that number.
count.name: Number

get_announcements.name: Get announcements

get_conversations.description: Returns the conversations of a Parro account with their latest message, from what Home Assistant already has, without opening them in Parro. Only the user of the account and automations can use it. The answer is kept in the trace of the automation or script.

config_entry_id.description: The Parro account to read. Leave it empty to use your own Parro account. Automations must choose one.
config_entry_id.name: Parro account

get_conversations.name: Get conversations

send_message.description: Sends a plain-text reply to a Parro conversation that is allowed in the options. At most one reply per conversation per minute, 5 per hour and 20 per day.

config_entry_id.description: The Parro account that sends the reply. Leave it empty to use your own Parro account. Automations must choose one.
config_entry_id.name: Parro account

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, from the Get conversations action or from the chat message event.
conversation_id.name: Conversation

message.description: Plain text of up to 1000 characters and 20 lines. Links, web addresses, IP addresses, e-mail addresses, HTML, markdown links and template code are refused.
message.name: Message

send_message.name: Send chat reply
